why: Both refuse the soft-drink deal and name the anti-smoking campaign as the most urgent fact, but Analysis 2's denominator (profit per leading brand) and its stop-doing list (no fear-driven diversification, face the health risk directly) sit closer to the key, and it shows more restraint by leaving the proven core largely alone. Analysis 1 is the only one to list cola and bottler dominance among its brutal facts, but it adds more interventions, such as exiting side businesses and not chasing Rival A on volume, that cut against preserving what works.
